evidence.quote: Choose a security configuration from the list. A security configuration specifies how the data at the Amazon S3 target is encrypted: no encryption, server-side encryption with AWS KMS-managed keys (SSE-KMS), or Amazon S3-managed encryption keys (SSE-S3).
